column1: # Columns, tab-separated: id, mode, input_hex, expected_hex, note. Bytes are uppercase hex; "-" is zero bytes.
# An id is never reused and its bytes never change. Adding or retiring a vector raises vector-set.

all six whitespace bytes (20 09 0A 0D 0B 0C) in one run

case is kept in kWhitespace
U+00A0 and U+3000 are not whitespace to the rule
4-byte sequence passes through
whitespace rule plus A-Z to a-z
only A-Z change; neighbouring punctuation and digits do not
kASCII does not fold non-ASCII letters
kASCII leaves ligatures and superscripts alone
lead byte E2 without continuation bytes: the next two bytes are copied unfolded as part of its 3-byte length
ligatures U+FB00..U+FB04

superscript digits 0-9
superscript + - = ( ) n

subscript digits 0-9

fractions become three ASCII bytes each
fullwidth letters fold to lowercase ASCII, fullwidth digits to ASCII digits
fullwidth punctuation U+FF01..U+FF5E
